name: R-Process Cluster
lore: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.
research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

name: String Coupling Crystal
lore: Tunes how strongly strings split and join. Turn it up and string theory becomes a different string theory.
research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

name: Banach-Tarski Sphere
lore: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.
research: Paradox Engineering - Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

name: Hyperdimensional Pearl
lore: A pearl that teleports to everywhere at once.

name: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum
lore: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Sterile Neutrino
lore: Interacts with nothing except gravity. Very hard to keep hold of.
research: Neutrino Physics - Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.

name: Virtual Graviton
lore: A quantum of gravity that has not yet decided to exist.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Virtual Monopole
lore: A magnet with one pole. The vacuum only lends these briefly.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Virtual Photon
lore: Light that never left anything and will never arrive.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Virtual Quark
lore: A quark borrowed from the vacuum. It wants to go back.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Void Essence
lore: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.

name: E8 Lattice
lore: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.
research: The Transfinite Hierarchy - Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

name: Error-Correction Lattice
lore: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Metamaterial Sheet
lore: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.
research: Metamaterials - Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.

name: Molecular Orbital Lattice
lore: Electron wavefunctions shared between atoms, frozen into a grid. This is what a chemical bond is.
research: Quantum Chemistry - Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

name: Quantum Field Lattice
lore: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.
research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

name: Standard Model Matrix
lore: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.
research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

name: Absolute Notes I
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Absolute Notes II
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Absolute Notes III
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Empirical Notes I
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

name: Empirical Notes II
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

name: Empirical Notes III
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

name: Holographic Matrix
lore: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.
research: The Holographic Principle - Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

name: Theoretical Notes I
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

name: Theoretical Notes II
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

name: Unified Notes I
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

name: Unified Notes II
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

name: Unified Notes III
lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

name: Chronosteel Ingot
lore: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.

name: Computronium Ingot
lore: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.

name: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot
lore: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.

name: Crystalline Matrix Ingot
lore: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.

name: Flerovium Ingot
lore: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.
research: The Island of Stability - Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

name: Hypernova Alloy Ingot
lore: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.
research: Stellar Transcendence - Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

name: Massless Alloy
lore: The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.
research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

name: Metallic Hydrogen Ingot
lore: Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.
research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

name: Negative Mass Ingot
lore: Push it and it comes toward you.
research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

name: Neutronium Ingot
lore: Stabilised neutron-degenerate matter.

name: Omnium Ingot
lore: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.

name: Spacetime Alloy Ingot
lore: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.

name: Stellar Iron Ingot
lore: Iron from the core of a star - the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.
research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

name: Transcendent Metal Ingot
lore: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.
research: Stellar Transcendence - Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

name: Unbihexium Ingot
lore: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.
research: The Island of Stability - Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

name: Causal Shield Lattice
lore: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that hit it are deflected into somebody else's timeline.
research: Chronodynamics - If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.

name: Cherenkov Lattice
lore: Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.

name: Eigenstate Lattice
lore: The states a measurement is allowed to find, and no others.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Gravitational Wave Crystal
lore: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.
research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

name: Metal-Organic Framework
lore: Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram.
research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

name: Neural Lattice
lore: Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.
research: Artificial Intelligence - Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

name: Russell Paradox Set
lore: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?
research: Paradox Engineering - Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

name: Spinor Lattice
lore: Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.
research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

name: Thought Matrix
lore: A thought, frozen in a lattice so it can be copied.
research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

name: Zeolite Catalyst
lore: A crystal full of molecule-sized pores; reactions that fit inside go faster.
research: Chemical Bonding - Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.

name: Empty Containment Cell
lore: A magnetically sealed flask for fluids too hot, too cold or too strange for a bucket. Scoop a source block or fill it from a tank.

name: Cosmic String Lens
lore: A loop of cosmic string bends light into perfect focus. A lithography catalyst.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor
lore: The protein in a robin's eye that feels Earth's field through entangled radical pairs.
research: Quantum Biology - Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.
